temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth has been unusually curt over the past few days. When Keith asks if he upset her, she says no, not at all, and explains she is dealing with personal stuff and is sorry if she seemed short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Keith believes Elizabeth may be upset with him, possibly because of an unknown misunderstanding or mistake.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Elizabeth's curtness is not due to anger at Keith; it is due to personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not upset with him; she is dealing with personal issues.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To be understanding and offer support or check in with Elizabeth.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Keith offers support and suggests a coffee break. Elizabeth says this is kind and accepts, thanking him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is not upset with him but is dealing with personal stress; he wants to support her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Elizabeth is receptive to his support and agrees to a coffee break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth welcomes his support and is willing to spend time with him; a coffee break may help.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To follow through with the coffee break and listen to and support Elizabeth.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe. Keith suggests professional help; Elizabeth says she has thought about it but is hesitant and unsure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under significant personal stress and is receptive to Keith's support; talking together may help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Her stress may warrant professional help, but she is hesitant about seeking it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Professional help could benefit Elizabeth, but she is not ready or certain; Keith should be careful and gentle.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, empathetic, and cautious about offending her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently encourage professional help without pressuring her, while continuing to offer support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his professional-help suggestion. After Keith apologizes and reassures her, she says he did not overstep, appreciates his concern, and says it is a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is hesitant about professional help, and Keith is worried he may offend her by suggesting it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: First, her withdrawal makes him believe he may have embarrassed or overstepped. Then her reply updates him: she says he did not overstep and appreciates his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: He did not offend her; she appreciates his support but is still processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Regretful and concerned during the withdrawal, then reassured but still concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To reassure her, avoid pushing, and continue supporting her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Following their last conversation, Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative. In dialogue, she says his support means a lot and she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the last conversation, Keith believed he had not offended Elizabeth and that she appreciated his support, though she was still processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes/confirms—Seeing her more open and hearing her thanks strengthens his belief that she values his support and feels more comfortable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better knowing she has it; their supportive relationship is strong.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to Elizabeth.
